text:
Lina - CSM: PolariSPay reported higher-than-usual bills during nightly reconciliation. Their traffic is mostly short chat prompts (~20 tokens) but a small proportion of long batch queries. Wants pre-renewal cost savings options.

Omar - ML Eng: Sounds like a good fit for mixed routing + compact quant. Short interactive requests -> compact-int8/int4; long batches -> standard fp16 or dedicated pool. Need to validate numeric accuracy on reconciliation prompts.

Claudia - SuccessOps: Recommend a conservative pilot: 4% traffic to int8 compact for <=48 tokens, route longer ones untouched. Add automatic fallback and a strict quality check on key templates. Goal: reduce monthly token bill by >=12% or p95 < 350ms.

Ben - EngOps: Add runtime guards: don't ramp during 02:00-04:00 local where recon jobs run. Alert if numeric-diff rate >0.8% or p95 increases by >10%.

Omar - ML Eng: I'll run a 600-sample regression test against their reconciliation prompts and compute embedding-similarity + numeric-equality checks. Quick estimate: int8 reduces token latency ~30% on avg and cost ~18% for short requests.

Lina - CSM: Good. Can we offer this as a "renewal optimization" trial? If it meets acceptance (>=12% cost savings OR p95 improvement >=10% with <=1% quality delta) include in renewal credits.

Claudia - SuccessOps: I'll draft the one-pager and SRE checklist. Also include a rollback play: instant route revert + cache flush.

Ben - EngOps: Suggested route policy (dry-run):

```
route_rules:
  - name: polaris-short-quant
    match: "request.tokens <= 48 && rand() < 0.04"
    target_model: gpt-compact-int8-v2
    fallback: gpt-compact-fp16-v1
    latency_slo_ms: 350
    quality_checks: [embedding_similarity, numeric_match]
  - name: polaris-long
    match: "request.tokens > 48"
    target_model: gpt-standard-fp16-v2
    priority: high
slo_guards:
  window_minutes: 10
  p95_increase_pct_threshold: 10
  numeric_diff_threshold_pct: 0.8
```

canary-bot: canary workspace created: /canaries/3987654321-preview. Alerts: /alerts/3987654321. Dry-run deployed.

Omar - ML Eng: Plan: post regression numbers and a short QA summary by EOD tomorrow. If clean, we can ramp to 15% off-peak for 12 hours to gather stronger signal.

Lina - CSM: I'll loop in PolariSPay and schedule a 30m ops sync. Action items: Omar -> regression + perf numbers; Claudia -> docs + checklist; Ben -> set alerts + dry-run; Lina -> customer coordination. Will update thread. :rocket:
